title: Artist Playlist Dominance Transition
scenario: Identify the top 3 artists by playlist adds each month, then find artists who moved up in rank for 3 consecutive months.
tableSchema: artists (art_id INT), songs (song_id INT, art_id INT), playlists (list_id INT, song_id INT, added_date TIMESTAMP)
hint: Rank monthly, then use LAG to compare rank positions.
correctQuery: WITH monthly_rank AS (SELECT art_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', added_date) as mon, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', added_date) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rnk FROM songs JOIN playlists USING (song_id) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT art_id FROM (SELECT art_id, rnk, LAG(rnk) OVER(PARTITION BY art_id ORDER BY mon) as p1, LAG(rnk, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY art_id ORDER BY mon) as p2 FROM monthly_rank) t WHERE rnk < p1 AND p1 < p2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE artists (art_id INT); CREATE TABLE songs (song_id INT, art_id INT); CREATE TABLE playlists (list_id INT, song_id INT, added_date TIMESTAMP);
